Added JXL MIME and extension support, enabled HEIC and JXL previews for macOS/iOS Safari 17+, and simplified MIME detection in both Drive upload paths to use the file type followed by the extension.

The focused Drive tests passed (12 tests total). ESLint, Prettier, and diff checks passed. The project type check still reports five errors outside the changed files.
